scope: Independent source/test/report inspection only. QA did not execute an engine, import or render for this review.

owner_report.execution_attribution: Component owner, not independently rerun by QA. Synthetic semantic-mask/material fixture.

observed_strengths: No extra SkeletonModifier or skeleton/gameplay writes. Binding is staged before overrides are applied.
Analytic critically damped constant-target integration; masks preserve zero-weight anchors; cloth and metallic hem share a displacement field.
Pause holds report state, invalid delta resets without catch-up, teleport/death/respawn clear inertia and repeated dead samples hold without reset accumulation.
Report compares varying input at 90 identical elapsed-time samples: maximum cloth differences 0.000420695 m at 30/120 Hz and 0.000140319 m at 60/120 Hz against a declared 0.002 m tolerance.
Texture/scalar/channel preservation has a synthetic check; missing masks, colored masks and an emission-enabled material have reject-without-override counterexamples.

requested_counterexamples.mechanism: Each yaw is checked finite, but yaw minus the previous yaw is computed before angle wrapping. Consecutive finite values 1e308 then -1e308 overflow the difference. This must not send a nonfinite turn, spring offset or shader uniform to the renderer.
requested_counterexamples.requested_resolution: Normalize accepted yaw before storing/subtracting or reject a bounded input range; execute the consecutive finite-extreme counterexample and assert published state remains finite.

requested_counterexamples.mechanism: The shader uses diffuse_burley and specular_schlick_ggx, while the conversion admission guard does not compare StandardMaterial3D diffuse_mode and specular_mode. A targeted nondefault source can therefore be silently reinterpreted.
requested_counterexamples.requested_resolution: Preserve or reject unsupported diffuse/specular modes and include an atomic no-override counterexample.

requested_counterexamples.mechanism: Publishing transforms offset through mesh.global_basis.inverse() and visual.global_basis. Current input checks do not cover nonfinite or singular mesh transforms.
requested_counterexamples.requested_resolution: Either validate finite nonsingular transform inputs or explicitly restrict and verify the imported-asset transform contract in integration. A finite CPU spring report alone does not establish finite published GPU uniforms.

remaining_gates: Final actual-asset mask admission, imported-source freshness and cross-component action/contact regressions.
Actual source-matched A/B sequential rendering; CPU mirror tests do not accept GPU displacement, shadow/normal response, collision or visual quality.
Production art, physical cloth/strands, physical-GPU frame pacing and commercial-game parity remain OPEN/UNRUN.
